SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
SPECIAL REGISTRY
No. N. 456
Date 30/10/40

October 30, 40.

A.H. George, Esq.,
Consul General,
H.B.M. Consulate General.
CONFIDENTIAL

Dear Mr. George,

I am sorry but the enquiries in con-
nection with your letter dated October 24, 1940
concerning Wootten and Gensburger are taking
longer than expected. I hope to be able to let
you have a report by the end of the week.

Yours sincerely,

Sd. K. M. Bourne
Commissioner of Police.

Personal and confidential .

BRITISH CONSULATE-GENERAL
SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
REGISTRY
October 24th 1940.
No. 45/
30 / 10 / 40

Dear Bourne,

We are making confidential enquiries about a British subject named Gerald Owen Wootten, formerly resident at Shanghai but now in San Francisco, where he arrived in the summer of 1939, whose activities are suspect.

According to our records, he was born at Hammersmith, London, on 2nd October 1894; profession: architect; holds passport No.1026, issued at His Majesty's Consulate-General at Shanghai. His wife, Madeleine Louise (née Ollerdessen) born 5th April, 1894, and daughter, Madeleine Louise, born 14th September, 1921, are still here at No.205 Peking Road.

I have reason to believe that he is associated with Victor Gensburger, believed to be a French national of Jewish descent, senior partner of the Shanghai firm of S. Gurkha Levi and Company, who is apparently also now in San Francisco. I have an idea that a person of this name got into trouble with the French Concession police last year in connection with an indecent assault as a result of which he left for America - but I may be wrong.

In any case I would be most grateful for any information already on the police records or which you may be able to obtain about Gensburger and his political or other associations, as well as about Wootten and his antecedents.

D.S.J. Macadam
£ 27/10.

Yours sincerely,
[Signature]
CONFIDENTIAL
DC (Genl Sp Br)
Enq attache plan

上海公共租界工部局警务处
登记室
1940年10月24日。
编号 45/
1940年10月30日

亲爱的 Bourne：

我们就一名名为 Gerald Owen Wootten 的英国臣民进行机密查询。此人原居上海，现于旧金山，他于1939年夏季抵达该地，其活动可疑。

根据我方记录，他于1894年10月2日出生于伦敦哈默史密斯（Hammersmith）；职业：建筑师；持有护照第1026号，由大英帝国陛下驻沪总领事馆签发。其妻 Madeleine Louise（娘家姓 Ollerdessen），生于1894年4月5日，其女 Madeleine Louise，生于1921年9月14日，仍居住在北京路205号。

我有理由相信他与 Victor Gensburger 有牵连。据信 Gensburger 为法籍犹太人，是上海 S. Gurkha Levi and Company 商行的资深合伙人，显然目前也在旧金山。我印象中，去年有一个同名之人因涉及猥亵袭击案而与法租界警方发生纠葛，并因此前往美国——但也可能是我记错了。

无论如何，如贵处警务档案中已有关于 Gensburger 及其政治或其他关联的信息，或者您能获取此类信息，以及关于 Wootten 及其背景的信息，我将不胜感激。

D.S.J. Macadam
£ 27/10.

此致，
[签名]
机密
DC (总务特别科)

1.

关于葡萄牙籍人士在朝鲜人海洛因窝点被日本领事警察逮捕一事。
----------------------------------------

1940年12月9日下午2时，隶属于日本领事警察局的警佐 S. Kibe 将一名名为 Francisco Xavier Baptista 的男子带至警局。Baptista，31岁，葡萄牙籍，男/推销员，住南天潼路548弄12B号。Kibe 警佐称，上述人员于1940年12月9日下午1时30分左右，在海宁路泰兴里118号的朝鲜人海洛因窝点被日本领事警察局成员逮捕，当时警方正在对该地址进行突击搜查。

该警官进一步陈述，被捕者（F. Baptista）在被捕时声称自己是中国籍臣民，但根据其外貌，强烈怀疑其为日本人，因此将其带往日本领事警察局办公室。在那里，他通过出示护照证明了其国籍（葡萄牙籍），随后被移交给上海公共租界工部局警务处（S.M.P.）处理。经本人在警局讯问，F. Baptista 称，他进入上述海洛因窝点（即前述被捕地点）是为了看望他的一位中国朋友。已与葡萄牙领事 J.A.L. De Mello 博士取得联系，领事指示本人

Italian Banker, Niece Missing
10 Days From Cathay Mansions

Mr. Ugo Caben d'Anvels,
wealthy 68-year-old Italian,
and his niece, Miss Carletti,
who arrived here last November,
have been missing from the
Cathay Mansions for the last 10
days, THE CHINA PRESS learned
yesterday.

The hotel management informed
the French police authorities yes-
terday, and the latter commenced
investigations upon obtaining au-
thority from the Italian Consulate-
General here, it was also learned.
So far no clues that may throw
some light on the disappearance
have been discovered.

Mr. Piero V. E. Terni, a personal
friend of the missing banker, has
been attempting in vain to reach
Mr. d'Anvels at his hotel for the
past ten days; it was learned. He
approached the management yes-
terday. The French police were
notified.

Mr. d'Anvels disappeared
with his young niece "about
ten days ago," according to
the hotel management, during
the labor strike that temporari-
ly drove out many other resi-
dents. He took with him, as
far as the management knows,
only his shaving equipment
and some brushes from the
dressing table. He left no for-
warding address and has not
communicated with the hotel
since. Outstanding was an un-
paid hotel bill.

Mr. d'Anvels, it was reliably
learned, arrived in Shanghai last
November and put up at the
Metropole Hotel. He moved into the
Cathay Mansions on January 25. A
well-known banker connected with
a large French concern, Mr.
d'Anvels has a street, the Rue
d'Anvels, named after him in Paris.

A personal friend of the missing
banker explained yesterday that
Mr. d'Anvels was traveling around
the world last year, and stopped in
Peking before coming to Shang-
hai.

E.S. Bonnell
Enquiries please
by 2/14
page_data.zh:
意大利银行家及其侄女
自国泰公寓失踪已十日

《字林西报》（THE CHINA PRESS）昨日获悉，68岁的富有意大利人 Ugo Caben d'Anvels 先生及其侄女 Carletti 小姐（去年11月抵沪）已从国泰公寓（Cathay Mansions）失踪十天。

据悉，酒店管理层已于昨日通知法国警方当局，后者在获得驻沪意大利总领事馆的授权后开始了调查。截至目前，尚未发现任何有助于查明失踪原因的线索。

据悉，失踪银行家的私人朋友 Piero V. E. Terni 先生在过去十天里一直试图在酒店联系 d'Anvels 先生，但均未成功。他于昨日联系了酒店管理层。法国警方已获通知。

据酒店管理层称，d'Anvels 先生与其年轻侄女“约十天前”失踪，当时正值劳工罢工期间，许多其他居民暂时搬离。据管理层所知，他仅带走了剃须用具和梳妆台上的一些刷子。他未留下转寄地址，此后也未与酒店联系。尚有一笔未付的酒店账单。

据可靠消息，d'Anvels 先生于去年11月抵达上海，入住大都会酒店（Metropole Hotel）。他于1月25日搬入国泰公寓。d'Anvels 先生是一位与一家大型法国企业有关的知名银行家，巴黎有一条以他命名的街道，即 d'Anvels 街（Rue d'Anvels）。

这位失踪银行家的一位私人朋友昨日解释说，d'Anvels 先生去年环游世界，在来上海之前曾停留于北平。

E.S. Bonnell
